description: (K)₂NaBiBr₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaBiBr₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaBiBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form BiBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-Br bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Bi atom.
